newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific BBA a "buy".
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific BBA a "buy".

text.p: Brokerage firm Macquarie Equities said on Thursday it continued its buy recommendation on Pacific BBA Ltd, citing the Melbourne-based company's surging automotive component sales in the United States and strong plastics and engineering operations.
The broker, a unit of Macquarie Bank Ltd, said it estimated that Pacific BBA was undervalued by up to 20 percent, allocating the stock a market price of between A$4.20 and A$4.50 per share.
The stock closed at A$3.84 on Wednesday, near its year high of A$3.92. Earlier in the week, the company announced a five year A$200 million contract with an unidentified U.S. car maker.

The broker said the PBR Automotive unit would be supplying product to about 45 percent of General Motors Corp's U.S. domestic car sales by 1998 while its Webforge engineering unit and the plastics division were expanding into Asia.
"There are very few Australian industrial companies that can rival PBB status as a growth stock," it said, and forecast earnings growth of 40 percent over 1996 to 1998.
